approval_ref: Continue improving CIRP efficiency, accuracy and adaptability across RFI, Submittal and Email content.
notes: Reuse the existing Ask the project flow and complete cached workflow index.
Recognize only strict otherwise-unspecified Email Subject, sender, recipient and Date questions.
Answer locally only when the selected run contains exactly one analyzed Email.
Read only current EMAIL > HEADERS parser evidence; exclude body and quoted history.
Block multiple Email files, conflicting or missing current values and the bounded passage overflow.
Use synthetic evidence and make no provider or mailbox request.
title: Answer unambiguous single-Email headers locally
objective: Reduce latency and avoid arbitrary Email selection for exact current-header questions without weakening source, thread or quoted-history boundaries.
